    LLM multi-agent systems split work across agents that communicate through text. An agent summarizes its findings, another agent receives the text. This constrains communication to discrete tokens and costs redundant compute, limiting bandwidth and capabilities of multi-agent systems. Recent works demonstrate KV-cache transfer between LLMs but they either require the LLMs to be within the same family or cannot function across context, thus requiring the receiver to prefill text. We present SwaT (Swarm Telepathy), the first cross-family KV-cache transfer method that allows prefill-free communication in multi-family multi-agent systems. In an agent-to-agent communication setting, combining SwaT with recent advances in KV-cache compaction beats text-to-text communication in both accuracy and speed, with a mean of $40\%$ higher accuracy and a mean of $4\times$ faster wall-clock time. Experiments show SwaT achieves high performance on 17 benchmarks across 12 LLMs and 6 families. Additionally, given a sender Vision-Language Model (VLM), SwaT is able to transfer the vision capabilities to a text-only receiver LLM exceeding text-to-text communication despite SwaT being trained on text-only data. SwaT keeps both sender and receiver models frozen without fine-tuning and only requires $<50M$ tokens and $<1$ GPU-day to train.

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought prompting enables reasoning in large language models but produces explanations that are difficult to verify, expensive to generate, and not always faithful. We introduce a Structural Chain-of-Thought framework where models generate executable computational graphs instead of free-form reasoning. The final answer is obtained by deterministically executing the graph. The model is trained using graph-based reinforcement learning that rewards structural validity, answer correctness, and node overlap with reference graphs. Experiments across five benchmarks and four model families show that our method consistently improves accuracy over supervised graph training and can reduce generation length by up to 5-6x compared with standard GRPO and chain-of-thought supervised training. Our faithfulness experiments reveal that models trained with our approach tend to rely on deriving their answers from the generated graphs rather than producing post-hoc rationalizations as usually in chain-of-thought reasoning.

    ENGLISH

    Unified vision-language models (VLMs) perform both text-to-image (T2I) and image-to-text (I2T) generation with one shared Transformer backbone, yet how the backbone processes the condition in either direction remains poorly understood. We study this question from the perspective of conditional guidance: we probe every attention head to show the activation difference between two branches of classifier-free guidance (CFG) with different conditional guidance. On two unified VLMs of autoregressive and masked-diffusion paradigms, the probing reveals a subset of heads that are more sensitive to the change of condition while others are agnostic to it. This characteristic pattern holds in both T2I and I2T generation and is largely stable across data samples, demonstrating the internal mechanism of unified VLMs. Motivated by this, we propose a new inference-time intervention approach for unified multimodal generation, named \textit{HeadTuned-CFG}, which uses the probed condition-change awareness to select and tune the conditional guidance at the attention-head level. Experiments show consistent benefits in both multimodal generation directions of unified VLMs without additional training, and in particular substantial improvements over strong baselines in T2I generation. These results further support the key finding of our probing analysis: the observed pattern of functional specialization is an intrinsic property of unified VLMs.

    We introduce Sequent-Prover, a family of verifier-using language-model agents, and the post-training framework that produces them. Our recipe, verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation, bootstraps from a noisy teacher proposal policy by sampling multi-turn trajectories, retaining the successful tail that is correct, non-trivial, grounded, and executable, then applying supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level preference optimization. Across 37 benchmarks and 7,254 problems per model family, post-training raises the 4B model's per-attempt accuracy from 85.6% to 97.0% and four-sample all-correct reliability (pass^4}) from 64.1% to 91.7%.     The paper directly measures the stability and relational geometry of internal knowledge representations across elicitation conditions, then uses that stability in a knowledge-editing policy.     本文直接衡量不同引出条件下内部知识表征及其关系几何结构的稳定性，并将这种稳定性用于知识编辑策略。基准中包含数学推理，但本文的主要贡献并非推理方法；编辑与模型记忆相关，但未提出更广泛的记忆架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models are typically evaluated in terms of the correctness of their output. However, output correctness alone does not confirm whether the latent knowledge supporting an answer has stable internal representations. We therefore propose latent state stability (LSS) and knowledge topology stability (KTS) to investigate the stability of individual knowledge states and their relational structure, respectively. Specifically, we first separately average the model's internal representations of the same knowledge under each elicitation condition. Using the mean representation under the baseline condition as a reference, we remove shared shifts to obtain corrected representations. We then formulate LSS as the distance between each corrected representation and its reference representation, normalized against the typical distance between knowledge items of the same type. We formulate KTS as the cross-condition consistency of the ordered pairwise representation distances among knowledge items of the same type. Next, we construct EpiStableBench, which comprises 4,411 items spanning factual knowledge and mathematical reasoning, with 76,766 controlled queries. Across 16 LLMs from four families, representation stability varies substantially even among items answered correctly under the base condition. Within models, higher stability generally corresponds to higher accuracy under held-out elicitation conditions; across models, stability does not consistently increase with model size or overall accuracy. Meanwhile, we present LatentDPO to learn a knowledge-editing policy that accounts for the stability of latent knowledge. Experimental results show that integrating LatentDPO with multiple existing editing methods consistently improves editing success and generalization across different expressions.

    大型语言模型通常依据其输出是否正确来进行评估。然而，仅凭输出正确并不能确认支撑答案的潜在知识是否具有稳定的内部表征。因此，我们提出潜在状态稳定性（LSS）和知识拓扑稳定性（KTS），分别考察单个知识状态及其关系结构的稳定性。具体而言，我们首先分别对模型在每种引出条件下关于同一知识的内部表征求平均。然后以基线条件下的平均表征为参照，去除共享偏移以得到校正后的表征。接着，我们将 LSS 定义为每个校正后表征与其参考表征之间的距离，并以同类知识条目之间的典型距离进行归一化。我们将 KTS 定义为不同条件下同类知识条目之间有序成对表征距离的一致性。随后，我们构建了 EpiStableBench，其中包含 4,411 个条目，涵盖事实知识和数学推理，并含有 76,766 个受控查询。在来自四个系列的 16 个 LLM 上，即使是基线条件下回答正确的条目，其表征稳定性也存在显著差异。在模型内部，较高的稳定性通常对应于在留出引出条件下更高的准确率；在不同模型之间，稳定性并不会随着模型规模或总体准确率的提升而持续提高。与此同时，我们提出 LatentDPO，以学习一种考虑潜在知识稳定性的知识编辑策略。实验结果显示，将 LatentDPO 与多种现有编辑方法结合，能够持续提升编辑成功率以及对不同表达方式的泛化能力。

    ANTE 训练编码智能体预测行动后果，通过执行验证这些信念，并将其用于逐步 RL 信用分配和测试时行动选择。这项工作显著推动了智能体架构与行动规划；可迁移的前瞻能力和信用分配也支撑了较强的推理评价，而仅有内部信念并不能证明其在机制可解释性或组合泛化方面有贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Rapid advances in large language models have made software engineering agents capable of tackling complex coding tasks. Within a containerized environment, a coding agent receives tool responses or execution results, and determines its later actions by those earlier results. However, most existing coding agents never look ahead: their policies do not anticipate the consequences of actions, and the terminal reward barely attributes a failure to certain earlier steps, so an ill-judged edit can corrupt the repository state irreversibly before any signal arrives. Recent code world models aim to address these challenges, but they are either trained and then frozen before reinforcement learning (RL), or reduced to an auxiliary next-token loss on the environment's outputs. We present ANTE (Anticipate, Then Execute), an agentic RL framework that verifies the policy's pre-action predictions by real execution and turns them into per-step credit for its actions and trust-or-abstain decisions. With an internal belief stated before each action, Belief-Anchored Policy Optimization (BAPO) turns the settled predictions into per-step advantages by anchoring credit on the policy's own forecasts. To turn the trained forecasts into better actions at inference, thereby facilitating effective test-time scaling, ANTE-TTO (test-time optimization) selects among candidate actions without an external scorer. ANTE raises Qwen3-32B from 25.0% to 57.2% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified, 6.2% above a matched GRPO baseline trained without the belief state; its world model's accuracy climbs from 44% to 69% during RL, and the learned foresight capability transfers across harnesses and out-of-distribution domains. In summary, we aim to build a code world model that knows what has happened, what holds now, and what the next action will achieve.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large reasoning models generate reasoning trajectories token by token. At a given prefix, multiple next-token candidates may be plausible, yet shape subsequent reasoning and differ in their chances of leading to the correct answer. Whether these differences are reflected in internal representations remains unclear. To study this question, we define relative long-horizon candidate value to quantify within-prefix differences and construct the Reasoning Candidate-Token Value (RCTV) dataset, pairing mathematical reasoning prefixes with plausible next-token candidates and their empirical long-horizon candidate values. Using RCTV, we examine hidden states, multilayer perceptron outputs, and attention outputs at candidate positions with sparse linear probes. Experimental results provide evidence that relative long-horizon candidate value is linearly decodable from these representations at multiple layers. Candidate-value probes can also outperform probability- and embedding-based baselines. Furthermore, a controlled online intervention experiment shows that using the decoded signals to guide token selection during generation can improve the chances of eventual success. Our findings provide evidence that internal representations encode information about relative long-horizon candidate value, offering insights into how local candidate-level representations relate to long-horizon reasoning outcomes.

    本文的核心贡献是一种统一的迭代式状态框架，用于多模态思维链，并训练模型保留、纠正和改进推理状态。这直接推进了推理研究；其模型框架并未对内部表征、组合性或更广泛的系统组织提供实质性洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) substantially enhances the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by explicitly modeling intermediate reasoning processes. However, most learning-based MCoT methods follow a stage-centric paradigm, where different reasoning behaviors are assigned to predefined stages and optimized separately. This results in fragmented reasoning and a training-inference reasoning-state gap. To address these limitations, we propose ReState, a unified iterative reasoning framework that reformulates multimodal reasoning from a stage-driven pipeline into a state-driven dynamic process. It comprises two complementary components: Unified Reasoning State Modeling (URSM) and Closed-Loop Reasoning-State Learning (CRSL). URSM unifies reasoning construction, correct reasoning preservation, and erroneous reasoning correction as reasoning-state transitions within a shared state space, enabling these heterogeneous reasoning behaviors to be learned jointly. CRSL further incorporates self-generated historical reasoning states during training and recursively updates the current state during inference, thereby mitigating the reasoning-state gap and enabling iterative self-refinement without requiring an additional reflection module, critic, or independent correction stage. Furthermore, we construct VersaCoT-10K, a high-quality CoT dataset spanning eight visual reasoning domains, which provides diverse supervision for multi-domain reasoning and reasoning-state refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReState exhibits strong adaptability across different MLLM backbones and achieves strong performance on multiple public reasoning benchmarks, supporting the shift from stage-centric reasoning toward state-centric reasoning. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/YuChuang1205/ReState

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper argues, with theoretical and empirical support, that compositional generalization provides an alternative framework for understanding how model edits affect complex behavior. This directly advances compositional generalization and substantially concerns reasoning, while knowledge updating connects to model systems; it does not analyze internal representations or mechanisms.

    本文以理论和实证证据论证，组合泛化为理解模型编辑如何影响复杂行为提供了另一种框架。这直接推进了组合泛化研究，并与推理密切相关；知识更新也与模型系统有关，但本文并未分析内部表征或机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A central desideratum in model editing is generalization to complex tasks, which prior work formalizes under a direct generalization paradigm: treating and evaluating LLM behavior as an input-output mapping and expecting a factual update to alter outputs on reasoning tasks. Yet despite substantial empirical effort, the field consensus remains that such generalization is highly challenging and elusive. However, when we deploy the latest models in an in-the-wild chatbot-user setting, we surprisingly find that even classical editing methods exhibit remarkably fluent generalization behavior. This motivates us to revisit the obstacles to generalization and the limitations of the prevailing paradigm. We find that direct generalization is fundamentally constrained both theoretically and practically: theoretically, it suffers from an identifiability issue; and practically, existing approaches attempting to circumvent this are further hindered by the ambiguity of their constructed biases and by vulnerability to being overridden by other factors such as optimization dynamics. We instead identify compositional generalization, empowered by the increasingly strong reasoning and composition abilities of modern LLMs, as a theoretically grounded and empirically validated alternative. We validate this phenomenon across multiple models and editing methods, showing that such generalization behavior is widespread. Overall, we argue that generalizable model editing could be more than direct generalization, and call for a paradigm shift toward more generalizable and practically deployable knowledge update techniques.

    Linear attention promises the efficiency needed for long-context language modelling, yet its fixed-size recurrent state must simultaneously support ongoing computation and preserve information from an ever-growing history. This coupling has reinforced a prevailing view that the state's memory capacity defines the model's long-context capability. We challenge this presumed ceiling: \emph{recurrent computation need not bear the full burden of long-term storage}. We introduce NoteBank, a sparse episodic memory that archives selected text before future queries are known, uses the backbone's native features for writing and addressing, and reads retrieved evidence through its native forward computation via replay. This \emph{training-free, plug-and-play} interface requires no external embedding model, separately trained retriever, or separate neural reader. At one million tokens, it raises Gated DeltaNet's mean accuracy across six RULER retrieval tasks from 1.7% to 70.3%, with no observed significant retrieval degradation from 4K to 1M tokens. Experiments extend from three 1.3B recurrent backbones to Mamba-2-8B and post-trained Qwen3.5-9B, demonstrating gains on LongBench v1/v2 and MemoryAgentBench. Together, these results show that sparse evidence storage and native replay can substantially expand the long-context capability of pretrained linear attention models while retaining the efficiency of recurrent computation.

We then compare learners formed through different observation and update conditions but matched on specified reconstruction measurements.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes a spiral geometric account of role–filler binding, tests it with representational analyses and causal interventions in a neural model, and compares its predictions with human neural recordings.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A fundamental challenge in cognitive science and neural computation is the binding problem. Compositional generalization can be achieved by factorizing representations into roles, the structural slots of a representation (e.g., serial position or syntactic function), and fillers, the contents occupying them (e.g., a phoneme or a word), which can be recombined freely to represent novel combinations. How neural systems implement role--filler binding, however, remains unknown. One of its simplest cases is phoneme sequencing, where phoneme identity (filler) must be bound to position (role) so that /gum/ and /mug/ are represented differently. A proposal from NLP, the `onion hypothesis' (Csordas et al., 2024), holds that the direction of the neural population state encodes token identity, while its magnitude encodes position. It was formulated for random token sequences; we extend it to natural language and test it in neural models and the human brain. We first evaluated it in an encoder-decoder trained to repeat English words, using representational geometry analyses and causal interventions. Magnitude alone proves incomplete: position is encoded by magnitude together with a systematic rotation of the state direction, a scheme we formalize as the `spiral hypothesis'. We then analyzed intracranial recordings from the auditory cortex of 20 participants listening to short sentences. Across superior temporal gyrus electrodes, the change in population response between consecutive phonemes decreases in magnitude as position advances, and its direction is aligned within consonants and within vowels but near orthogonal across the two classes, supporting the magnitude coding shared by both accounts. These results provide a geometric account of how neural systems bind phoneme identity to position, and show how neural-model hypotheses can yield testable predictions about human neural computation.

We take intervention attribution, the first-order effect of a specified intervention on the model output, as our estimand. For a broad class of response functions, we show that observational feature-discovery evidence generally does not identify this attribution, and derive an exact gradient-based decomposition of the gap between linear-probe predictions and intervention attribution. Across four model-SAE pairs, median probe-to-attribution magnitude ratios range from tens to hundreds, while attributions closely track small-step steering. For single-latent ablations with nonzero effects, gradient predictions match the realized sign in 91-97% of cases, compared with 17-35% for probe-implied changes.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Text wrapped in a trigger can be made behaviorally invisible to a language model: omitted from summaries and quotations, ignored in question answering, and left unflagged by downstream filtering. We study this selective blindness as a dual-use information-flow primitive, a supply-chain backdoor, and a white-box auditing problem. We first implement it exactly as a serving-time span veto: blocking information flow out of a marked span makes every outside activation bit-identical under same-length substitution of the span's content, a noninterference property we verify across ten models, seven mixer families, and 0.5B-120B parameters. The veto serves as a deployable quarantine, an exact reference for calibrating leakage, and a teacher. Distilled into weights, it yields a backdoor: checkpoints trained on six model families from 4B to 120B ignore marked context at little benchmark cost, and their outputs show no measurable semantic trace of the suppressed content above the veto reference on our held-out suite; an in-domain variant suppresses planted vulnerabilities during AI code review. Detection is therefore a white-box problem. Simpler backdoors remain internally transparent -- linear probes recover suppressed content at 0.57-0.79 accuracy versus 0.025 chance -- but hardening the attack until probes reach chance collapses attention from outside the span into it below the range of base models. Across the attacks we evaluate, probe visibility trades off against routing visibility; we do not establish that this tradeoff is fundamental.

    Multi-agent LLM systems (MALS) introduce a privacy-leakage problem that conventional sensitivity-based defenses miss, since information disclosed to one authorized agent can propagate through routine coordination to an unauthorized one, without compromise or malicious behavior. This motivates topology-aware enforcement that blocks unauthorized propagation while preserving authorized disclosure. We evaluate 485 scenarios across coordinator-worker, peer-to-peer, and hierarchical topologies, instrumenting seven communication channels and measuring surface leakage and disclosure to topology-introduced recipients. We introduce RECONS, a Detect -> Decide -> Transform sanitizer conditioning intervention on recipient and execution context rather than sensitivity alone. Topology changes where protected information propagates, with disclosure to topology-introduced recipients rising from 0% to 52.2% while surface leakage stays nearly flat at 60.6-62.8%. This effect persists across four generator models and a second orchestration framework, though magnitude and relay paths differ; framework choice separately drives a 150x leakage spread, so topology alone is not sufficient. RECONS reduces residual disclosure from 96.7% without sanitization to 29.25%, preserving 94.1% of authorized disclosures versus 20.5% under blanket redaction. Detection coverage is the dominant bottleneck, accounting for 95.5% of residual disclosures. These results show that privacy enforcement in MALS must reason about the recipient and communication path realized at runtime, not sensitivity or topology assumptions alone.

We argue that the problems are largely due to agent-centric designs: the coordination structure is wired into fixed workflows, central coordinators, or peer-to-peer messaging, and recent blackboard-style methods that move the coordination into a shared medium relieve only the last problem. To close the gaps, we build ScaleMAS, where asynchronous agents interact with a shared datastore of linked messages via three operations: publishing messages with optional references to earlier ones that they build on, searching for messages by content, and visiting messages by address. Search returns at most $k$ messages, so an agent's read stays bounded at any group size; results are ranked by relevance and by how often they are cited, which we find to be an effective proxy for quality; and messages persist after their producers leave, so the group carries on when individual agents fail. Across four agentic tasks, ScaleMAS outperforms agent-centric and blackboard-style baselines at lower inference compute, continues to scale up to 128 agents, and tolerates losing agents midway.

    已有研究表明，基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统扩展性较差；我们指出了三个问题：阅读负担随群体规模增长、有用信息被质量未知的共享工作所稀释，以及系统容易受到智能体故障的影响。我们认为，这些问题主要源于以智能体为中心的设计：协作结构被固化在固定工作流、中央协调器或点对点消息传递中；近期将协作转移到共享媒介的黑板式方法仅缓解了最后一个问题。为弥补这些不足，我们构建了 ScaleMAS，其中异步智能体通过三种操作与一个共享的关联消息数据存储交互：发布消息（可选地引用其所基于的较早消息）、按内容搜索消息，以及按地址访问消息。搜索最多返回$k$条消息，因此无论群体规模如何，智能体的读取量都保持有界；结果按相关性和被引用次数排序，我们发现这两项是有效的质量代理指标；消息在其发布者离开后仍会保留，因此即使个别智能体发生故障，群体也能继续运行。在四项智能体任务中，ScaleMAS 以更低的推理计算量优于以智能体为中心和黑板式基线，可持续扩展至 128 个智能体，并能容忍智能体在中途退出。

    Pollard: Governed Semantic Execution Trees for Framework-Independent AI Agent Control and Replay

    Pollard：用于框架无关AI智能体控制与重放的受治理语义执行树

    Muntaser Syed, Marius C. Silaghi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Pollard’s main contribution is a governed execution-tree runtime for agent control, transactional resource coordination, and verified replay. Its agent execution is only an application of the system mechanisms, with no substantive advance in model reasoning or internal representations.

    Pollard的主要贡献是一个用于智能体控制、事务式资源协调和经验证重放的受治理执行树运行时。智能体执行只是对系统机制的应用，并未实质性推进模型推理或内部表示。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent frameworks can persist checkpoints, trace tool calls, and limit resource use, but these facilities often assign different identities to execution, governance, and replay. We present Pollard, a framework-independent runtime based on governed semantic execution trees. A step identity commits to canonical input, kind, attempt, and parent identity; the same tree records completion, refusal, resource settlement, and branch history. Strict replay returns a verified stored result without invoking the wrapped operation, while a transactional store coordinates reservations across concurrent workers. Under a signed deterministic freeze, two state-model replicas each executed the evaluation transitions without an invariant violation, retained-lease PostgreSQL groups were tested against exact limits, strict replay avoided external calls, and all semantic mutations were detected with no false alarms on the controls. A multi-pair framework matrix preserved reference behavior and verified the trees. A separate cost-capped hosted study exercised live provider paths, and every completed Pollard trial produced a verified tree. Together, the studies support the core mechanisms under explicit lease, boundary, and seal-custody assumptions.

    Burin Naowarat, Hao Tang, Sharon Goldwater

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly investigates how speech models represent word timing, finding low-dimensional circular trajectories across nine models and using them to segment words. This is a core representation-geometry contribution; segmentation is an application of that finding, not evidence of composition, reasoning, or systems work.

    本文直接研究语音模型如何表征词语时序，发现九种模型中都存在低维圆形轨迹，并利用这些轨迹进行词语切分。这是对表征几何的核心贡献；切分是该发现的应用，并不能证明组合能力、推理能力或系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speech timing is fundamental for speech models to recognize words accurately, but how word-timing information is represented in speech models remains underexplored. We study this question using the framework of representational geometry, which investigates whether and how concepts are represented in low-dimensional subspaces of the representation space. Prior work in cognitive neuroscience has shown that when HuBERT feature sequences are averaged across words of the same duration, they form near-circular trajectories from word onset to word offset in a two-dimensional "temporal subspace." Here we show that this circular structure of word timing is a general property of deep speech representations, by demonstrating its emergence in nine additional speech models covering both supervised and self-supervised. We then move beyond averaged word segments and show that in HuBERT, the circular trajectories are consistent enough at the level of individual words to perform word segmentation. Our approach, Rotary Segmentation (RoSeg), achieves 64.3% boundary F-score on Librispeech by detecting word boundaries when cycles complete in the temporal subspace. Although supervision is needed to identify a good subspace, nevertheless this result demonstrates much stronger implicit word knowledge in HuBERT than has previously been shown.

    中文

    语音时序对于语音模型准确识别词语至关重要，但语音模型如何表征词语时序信息仍未得到充分研究。我们借助表征几何这一框架研究该问题；该框架探究概念是否以及如何表征在表征空间的低维子空间中。认知神经科学的既有研究表明，将时长相同的词语对应的 HuBERT 特征序列取平均后，会形成从词语起始到结束的近圆形轨迹，位于二维“时间子空间”中。本文表明，这种词语时序的圆形结构是深度语音表征的一般属性：我们在另外九种涵盖监督式和自监督式方法的语音模型中展示了这一结构的出现。随后，我们不再局限于平均后的词语片段，并表明在 HuBERT 中，单个词语层面的圆形轨迹足够一致，可以用于词语切分。我们提出的方法 Rotary Segmentation（RoSeg）通过检测时间子空间中的周期何时完成来识别词语边界，在 Librispeech 上取得了 64.3% 的边界 F-score。尽管确定良好子空间需要监督信号，但这一结果仍表明，HuBERT 中隐含的词语知识远强于以往所展示的水平。

    Eugenie Shi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies orthogonal, causally effective residual-stream directions for moral reasoning style and judgment polarity, directly advancing representation geometry and internal mechanisms. It studies moral judgments, but does not establish compositional generalization or broader reasoning capability development.

    本文识别出对应于道德推理风格和判断极性的正交且具有因果效力的残差流方向，直接推进了表征几何和内部机制研究。本文研究了道德判断，但并未证实组合泛化能力或更广泛的推理能力发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models are increasingly deployed in morally and legally sensitive contexts, yet little is known about how they internally represent distinctions between moral reasoning styles. We ask whether a model's differential response to rule-framed and consequence-framed moral questions reflects distinct internal structure or merely surface lexical sensitivity. We construct a 2$\times$2 factorial dataset crossing reasoning style (rule-based vs. consequence-based framing) with judgment polarity (permissive vs. prohibitive), drawn from three established moral reasoning benchmarks and evaluated on a cleanroom test set of novel phrasings that includes conflict pairs where the two framings predict opposite labels. Using linear probing and activation steering, we identify two orthogonal directions in the residual stream: Dir-A tracks reasoning style and Dir-B tracks judgment polarity, each near-blind to the other factor (cross-correlation $|r| < 0.04$). This double dissociation replicates across three instruction-tuned models from different developers at comparable proportional depth, and it is not knife-edged in layer: the directions are recoverable and causally effective throughout an extended band of the network. Dir-A can causally change judgments, and in conflicting scenarios, it selectively corrects errors in rule-based judgments without changing consequence-based judgments, suggesting that it does not simply make the model more likely to accept everything. Generalization beyond the training templates is partial: the direction transfers across benchmark sources, but its advantage over lexical baselines on novel phrasings is modest. We therefore frame the result as moral reasoning style sensitivity, a geometrically dissociable and causally effective structure, rather than internalized normative reasoning.

    中文

    大型语言模型正日益应用于对道德和法律高度敏感的情境中，但人们对它们如何在内部表征不同的道德推理风格知之甚少。我们探究模型对以规则为框架和以结果为框架的道德问题作出不同回应，是否反映了不同的内部结构，还是仅仅对表层词汇敏感。我们构建了一个 2$\times$2 因子数据集，将推理风格（基于规则与基于结果的框架）与判断极性（许可性与禁止性）交叉组合；数据取自三个既有的道德推理基准，并在一个全新措辞的洁净室测试集上进行评估，该测试集包括两种框架会预测相反标签的冲突对。通过线性探测和激活引导，我们在残差流中识别出两个正交方向：Dir-A 跟踪推理风格，Dir-B 跟踪判断极性，二者各自对另一因素近乎不敏感（交叉相关性 $|r| < 0.04$）。这种双重分离现象在来自不同开发者的三个指令微调模型中均以相近的相对深度复现，而且并非局限于某一层：在网络中一个较宽的层段内，这些方向都可以被恢复并产生因果效应。Dir-A 能够因果性地改变判断；在相互冲突的情境中，它会有选择地纠正规则式判断中的错误，而不改变结果式判断，这表明它并非只是让模型更倾向于接受所有内容。对训练模板之外内容的泛化是有限的：该方向可以迁移到不同基准来源，但在新措辞上的表现仅略优于词汇基线。因此，我们将这一结果界定为对道德推理风格的敏感性：一种在几何上可分离且具有因果效力的结构，而不是内化的规范推理。

    Resample the Answer: Where to Spend Test-Time Compute in Recursive Reasoning

    重新采样答案：递归推理中测试时计算应投入何处

    Maxime Illouz

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies the answer latent state as carrying recursive failures and introduces compute-efficient gated resampling to recover them, directly advancing iterative reasoning. Its latent-state analysis gives transferable mechanistic insight, while puzzle solving alone provides only limited evidence for compositional generalization and system design.

    本文发现答案潜在状态承载着递归过程的失败信息，并提出一种计算高效的门控重采样方法来纠正这些失败，直接推动了迭代推理研究。其潜在状态分析提供了可迁移的机制性见解；但仅凭谜题求解，只能为组合泛化和系统设计提供有限证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive reasoning models such as the Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) iteratively refine two latent states: an answer state y, decoded into the output, and a reasoning state z, which is never decoded. Many of their failures have been attributed to bad basins, regions of latent space that trap the recursion on wrong answers. Recent test-time approaches perturb y, z or both to recover these failures, but the impact of this choice on performance, test-time compute efficiency and scaling properties remains unclear. Through controlled experiments on TRM, we find that a failed trajectory carries its failure in its answer state. At equal compute, in depth and in width, resampling y recovers more failures than any perturbation of z we tested, and the performance gap widens as the test-time compute budget grows. Our approach, Gated Answer Resampling (GAR), pairs this resampling of the answer state with the model's own halting head and restarts only the puzzles that the head rejects. With at most 64 restarts per puzzle and no training or hyperparameter search, GAR takes TRM from 85.9% to 99.4% on Sudoku-Extreme and from 68.8% to 85.6% on Pencil Puzzle Bench validation. On the same checkpoints, GAR also outperforms Probabilistic TRM (PTRM), which perturbs z at each step, even when PTRM uses 42 to 197 times as much compute.

    中文

    Tiny Recursive Model（TRM）等递归推理模型会迭代优化两个潜在状态：解码为输出的答案状态 y，以及从不被解码的推理状态 z。许多失败被归因于坏盆地，即潜在空间中会使递归过程陷入错误答案的区域。近期的测试时方法会扰动 y、z 或两者，以纠正这些失败，但这种选择对性能、测试时计算效率和扩展特性的影响仍不清楚。通过在 TRM 上进行受控实验，我们发现，失败轨迹的失败信息保留在其答案状态中。在深度和宽度相同、计算量相等的条件下，对 y 重新采样比我们测试过的任何 z 扰动都能纠正更多失败，而且随着测试时计算预算增加，性能差距会扩大。我们的方法门控答案重采样（GAR）将答案状态重采样与模型自身的停止判断头结合起来，只重新启动被该判断头拒绝的谜题。每道谜题最多重启 64 次，且无需训练或搜索超参数，GAR 就将 TRM 在 Sudoku-Extreme 上的得分从 85.9% 提升到 99.4%，在 Pencil Puzzle Bench 验证集上的得分从 68.8% 提升到 85.6%。在相同检查点上，GAR 也优于每一步都扰动 z 的概率 TRM（PTRM），即便 PTRM 使用的计算量是 GAR 的 42 到 197 倍。

In this work, we propose a new self-supervised framework for learning sentence representations, using a special type of neural network called a recursive hypernetwork. Our proposed model composes the representation of a sentence from representations of words by applying a recursive composition through the parse tree. We maintain a separate syntactic and semantic representation, and the semantic composition is guided by the information from the syntactic representation. To train this model, we introduce a novel set of six self-supervised tasks.     Haifeng Qian, David Mosallanezhad, Christian Munley, Adithya Renduchintala, Oleksii Kuchaiev

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes sampling-based reward estimation to improve credit assignment in reasoning RL, with results on math and coding tasks. Its compute overhead is incidental to the contribution, so the abstract supports only a low Systems score.

    本文提出基于采样的奖励估计方法，以改善推理 RL 中的信用分配，并在数学和编程任务上报告了结果。计算开销只是附带因素，因此摘要仅支持较低的系统评分。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) implemented with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has driven substantial progress in training reasoning language models. However, verifiable outcome rewards provide an imperfect measure of reasoning quality: a correct final answer may not be supported by the reasoning trace, whereas an incorrect rollout may contain a nearly correct reasoning trajectory. We present empirical evidence for this mismatch and hypothesize that the resulting reward noise contributes to instability in reinforcement learning for both reasoning accuracy and token efficiency. To address this credit assignment challenge, this paper proposes double-rollout reinforcement learning. For each sampled rollout, we truncate its reasoning trace, sample multiple continuations from the truncated prefix, and replace the original reward with the mean continuation reward, yielding a more robust estimate of reasoning quality. This double-rollout algorithm incurs only a moderate increase in compute cost and yet reaches substantially higher accuracies across math and coding tasks and across Qwen and Nemotron models than baseline algorithms with fewer RL steps. For example, using only DAPO data it trains Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B to reach 95.4% on AIME 2026, versus 91.5% by GRPO and substantially above state of the art for this model size, within 30 RL steps. When combined with length-based rewards, the same algorithm further improves the accuracy-efficiency Pareto frontier over existing efficiency optimizations. These findings suggest that the double-rollout reward estimation is an effective and cost-efficient way to improve both the accuracy and token efficiency of reasoning RL.

    中文

    采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）实现的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR），推动了推理语言模型训练取得显著进展。然而，可验证的结果奖励并不能完美衡量推理质量：正确的最终答案可能缺乏推理轨迹的支持，而错误的 rollout 也可能包含几乎正确的推理轨迹。我们提供了这种不匹配的实证证据，并假设由此产生的奖励噪声会导致强化学习在推理准确率和 token 效率方面不稳定。为应对这一信用分配挑战，本文提出双重 rollout 强化学习。对于每个采样得到的 rollout，我们截断其推理轨迹，从截断后的前缀采样多个续写，并用续写奖励的均值替换原始奖励，从而得到更稳健的推理质量估计。该双重 rollout 算法只会适度增加计算成本，却在数学和编程任务以及 Qwen 和 Nemotron 模型上，以更少的 RL 步数取得了显著高于基线算法的准确率。例如，仅使用 DAPO 数据训练时，该算法在 30 个 RL 步骤内使 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 在 AIME 2026 上达到 95.4%，而 GRPO 为 91.5%，且显著超过该模型规模的最先进水平。与基于长度的奖励结合时，同一算法还能进一步改善准确率—效率 Pareto 前沿，优于现有的效率优化方法。这些发现表明，双重 rollout 奖励估计是一种有效且成本高效的方法，可同时提升推理 RL 的准确率和 token 效率。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies a short-lived hidden-state spectral reorganization before attention sinks form and causally tests how changing that geometry alters later sink behavior.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Attention sinks are usually studied after they have formed. We ask whether a measurable hidden-state change appears beforehand and whether changing that geometry alters what happens later. To remove network depth as a shortcut, we compare prompts in the same model and at the same layer. When sink timing varies across prompts, simple spectral summaries of the hidden states add information beyond current attention, with the clearest prompt-specific signal in a short window about two to three layers before sink formation. The predictive strength varies across cohorts, so we treat the spectrum as a readout of a pre-sink state change rather than a universal warning statistic. The signal is broader than one measured extreme activation. We then modify only the singular values of the post-layer hidden states after current attention has already been computed. These interventions change later sink behavior in Qwen2.5, GLM-Z1, and GPT-OSS relative to norm-matched random spectral perturbations. In Qwen2.5, the immediate suppressive effect is accompanied by a reduction in next-layer query--key preference for position~0, and the learned spectral directions remain stable when estimated from substantially less training data. Together, the results show that attention sinks are preceded by a short spectral reorganization of hidden states, and directly perturbing this geometry can causally alter subsequent sink formation.

    注意力汇聚点通常是在形成之后才进行研究。我们探究隐藏状态是否会在此之前出现可测量的变化，以及改变这种几何结构是否会影响后续过程。为排除网络深度这一捷径，我们在同一个模型、同一层上比较不同提示。当不同提示中的汇聚点形成时间不同时，隐藏状态的简单谱摘要能提供当前注意力之外的信息，其中最清晰的提示特定信号出现在汇聚点形成前约两到三层的短暂窗口内。其预测能力因不同群组而异，因此我们将谱视为汇聚点形成前状态变化的读数，而非普遍适用的预警指标。该信号的范围也不局限于某一个测得的极端激活。接着，我们仅修改后层隐藏状态的奇异值，此时当前注意力已计算完成。相对于范数匹配的随机谱扰动，这些干预改变了 Qwen2.5、GLM-Z1 和 GPT-OSS 后续的汇聚点行为。在 Qwen2.5 中，随即出现的抑制效应伴随着下一层对位置 0 的查询--键偏好降低；即使使用少得多的训练数据估计，学得的谱方向仍保持稳定。总之，结果表明，注意力汇聚点形成之前会出现短暂的隐藏状态谱重组，直接扰动这一几何结构能够因果性地改变后续汇聚点的形成。

    One-Layer Transformers Provably Learn In-Context K-Nearest Neighbor Prediction with Chain-of-Thought

    Lyumin Wu and Yuan Cao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how a one-layer transformer learns K-NN prediction through chain-of-thought, with a construction, a negative result, and a gradient-descent recovery proof. Its central contribution directly concerns the formation of reasoning capability; compositional generalization is a related but secondary angle, while it does not study internal representations or model systems.

    本文分析单层 Transformer 如何通过思维链学习 K-NN 预测，并给出了一个构造、一个否定结果以及梯度下降恢复该构造的证明。其核心贡献直接涉及推理能力的形成；组合泛化是相关但次要的角度，而本文并未研究内部表征或模型系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-Thought (CoT) enables transformers to solve complex reasoning tasks by generating intermediate reasoning steps. Despite strong empirical success, the mechanisms by which such reasoning abilities emerge during training remain poorly understood, particularly from a theoretical perspective. In this work, we study this question in a stylized yet fully analyzable setting: in-context $\mathrm{K}$-nearest-neighbor ($\mathrm{K}$-NN) prediction with a one-layer transformer. Earlier work has demonstrated that one-layer transformers can be trained to perform $1$-NN without CoT (Li et al., 2024a) by having the softmax attention attend to the nearest neighbor in context. However, this result on $1$-NN cannot be extended to $\mathrm{K}$-NN for $K>1$, as softmax attention is much less naturally suited to attending to the 2nd through $K$-th nearest neighbors. We first give a rigorous negative result showing that this limitation already appears on a well-separated class of binary classification tasks for odd $K>1$. We then give an explicit construction of a one-layer transformer, and show that it can solve $\mathrm{K}$-NN via CoT reasoning. We further prove that, under a stylized training setup, gradient descent can recover this construction, thereby showing that transformers can acquire the capability to solve $\mathrm{K}$-NN through training. In addition, we show that the resulting trained model applies to a broader test class than that assumed in the training analysis. Our results shed light on how CoT expands the ability of transformers to learn and solve tasks that are otherwise hard to solve.

    中文

    思维链（CoT）通过生成中间推理步骤，使 Transformer 能够解决复杂推理任务。尽管其实证效果显著，但这类推理能力在训练过程中如何形成，其机制仍未得到充分理解，尤其是在理论层面。在这项工作中，我们在一个风格化但完全可分析的设定中研究这一问题：使用单层 Transformer 进行上下文内 $\mathrm{K}$-近邻（$\mathrm{K}$-NN）预测。先前研究已表明，通过让 softmax 注意力关注上下文中的最近邻，可以训练单层 Transformer 执行 $1$-NN，且无需 CoT（Li et al., 2024a）。然而，对于 $1$-NN 的这一结果无法推广到 $\mathrm{K}$-NN（当 $K>1$ 时），因为 softmax 注意力不太适合自然地关注第 2 个到第 $K$ 个最近邻。我们首先给出一个严格的否定结果，表明对于奇数 $K>1$，在一类良好分离的二元分类任务上就已存在这一局限。随后，我们明确构造了一个单层 Transformer，并证明它可以通过 CoT 推理解决 $\mathrm{K}$-NN。我们还进一步证明，在一个风格化的训练设定下，梯度下降能够恢复这一构造，从而表明 Transformer 可以通过训练获得解决 $\mathrm{K}$-NN 的能力。此外，我们表明，训练得到的模型适用的测试类别比训练分析中假设的类别更广。我们的结果阐明了 CoT 如何扩展 Transformer 学习和解决原本难以解决任务的能力。

    Chanyoung Moon, Travis Pence, Daisuke Yamada, Jiaqi Mo, Yanxin Zhang, Vikas Singh, Karthikeyan Sankaralingam

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FORGE’s main contribution is a hardware system that regenerates sparse MoE weights on-chip to reduce memory and communication costs, with measured throughput, latency, and KV-cache benefits. Its MoE focus is incidental to model-internal mechanisms, composition, and reasoning, so those directions score low.

    FORGE 的主要贡献是一种硬件系统，可在芯片上重新生成稀疏 MoE 权重，以降低内存和通信开销，并带来已测得的吞吐量、延迟及 KV 缓存收益。其 MoE 侧重点与模型内部机制、组合和推理没有直接关联，因此这些方向的贡献较低。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce FORGE (Fast On-chip Rotor Generation for Experts), a procedural weight generation system for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference. Rather than storing and loading every expert weight tensor from HBM, we show how a compact accelerator inside each Streaming Multiprocessor can regenerate them on-the-fly from $O(\log^2 d)$ rotor parameters per projection. Per replaced layer, gigabytes of stored expert weights are approximated with under a megabyte of seeds. This addresses the dual memory bottleneck of autoregressive Sparse MoE decode, where per-expert FFN operations are HBM-bandwidth-bound at small routed-token counts and the aggregate expert footprint forces multi-node Expert Parallelism (EP) with all-to-all traffic. We realize the approach as the Rotor Generation Unit (RGU), a fixed-function datapath that generates FFN weight tiles without competing with Tensor Core execution. With 30% of the MoE FFN layers replaced across five Sparse MoE models, we estimate 1.3-2.8x higher system throughput at matched GPU count and 1.10-1.15x lower per-user decode latency at short context. In exchange, downstream accuracy on three model families falls below that of the same model fine-tuned without rotor replacement, and the replacement ratio controls this tradeoff. FORGE also expands KV cache capacity by 1.2-2.6x. It is agnostic to the bit width at which weights are stored, so it can compose with quantization. The RGU is fully implemented/verified in SystemVerilog at ~0.9% SM area overhead (0.032 mm^2/SM, 7nm).

    中文

    我们提出 FORGE（专家快速片上转子生成），一种用于稀疏混合专家（MoE）推理的程序化权重生成系统。我们展示了如何利用每个流式多处理器内的紧凑型加速器，根据每个投影的 $O(\log^2 d)$ 个转子参数即时重新生成权重，而不必将每个专家权重张量都存储在 HBM 中并从中加载。对于每个被替换的层，原本需要存储数 GB 的专家权重，现在可用不到 1 MB 的种子近似表示。这解决了自回归稀疏 MoE 解码中的双重内存瓶颈：在路由 token 数量较少时，每个专家的 FFN 操作受 HBM 带宽限制；而专家权重总量过大，则迫使系统采用多节点专家并行（EP），并产生全对全通信流量。我们将这一方法实现为转子生成单元（RGU），这是一种固定功能数据通路，可生成 FFN 权重分块，且不会与 Tensor Core 执行争用资源。在五个稀疏 MoE 模型中替换 30% 的 MoE FFN 层后，我们估计在 GPU 数量相同的情况下，系统吞吐量可提高 1.3-2.8 倍，短上下文下每用户解码延迟可降低 1.10-1.15 倍。作为代价，在三个模型家族上，下游准确率低于未进行转子替换的同一模型微调后的准确率；替换比例决定了这一权衡。FORGE 还可将 KV 缓存容量扩大 1.2-2.6 倍。它不受权重存储位宽限制，因此可以与量化结合使用。RGU 已使用 SystemVerilog 完整实现并验证，SM 面积开销约为 0.9%（0.032 mm^2/SM，7nm）。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SPLICE discovers reusable operators from unlabeled mixtures and composes them into simulators for unseen equations, directly advancing compositional learning and generalization. Operator discovery does not by itself establish insight into neural mechanisms, general reasoning, or model and agent systems.

    SPLICE 从无标签混合数据中发现可复用算子，并将它们组合为针对未见方程的模拟器，直接推进了组合学习与泛化。算子发现本身并未提供关于神经机制、一般推理或模型与智能体系统的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Neural operator splitting composes a library of neural operators, one per physical mechanism, into zero-shot simulators of new equations. Existing approaches, however, require these mechanisms and their labels to be specified in advance. We ask whether a pretrained library can instead be adapted and grown from unlabeled trajectories in which multiple mechanisms act simultaneously. We introduce SPLICE, a framework that discovers operators without mechanism labels on mixture data. The contributions of the candidate operators to each trajectory are inferred by solving a convex optimization problem. A calibrated test then assigns each discovered operator the mechanism it implements. Failure cases are also detectable, when the library lacks the required physics or when mechanisms are insufficiently separable. Across one and two dimensional systems, the discovered operators recover mechanisms from unlabeled mixtures and compose into zero-shot simulators of unseen equations; a frozen library can also grow an operator for physics absent from pretraining, without labels and without forgetting. On Navier-Stokes, the discovered operators compose about as accurately as their supervised counterparts.

    神经算子分裂将一个神经算子库（每种物理机制对应一个算子）组合起来，从而对新的方程进行零样本模拟。然而，现有方法要求事先指定这些机制及其标签。我们探讨能否改造并扩展一个预训练库，使其从多种机制同时作用的无标签轨迹中学习。我们提出 SPLICE，这一框架能够在混合数据上发现算子，而无需机制标签。每条轨迹中候选算子的贡献通过求解凸优化问题来推断。随后，经过校准的测试会判定每个发现的算子所实现的机制。该框架还能够检测失败情形，例如库中缺少所需物理机制，或机制之间无法充分区分。在一维和二维系统中，所发现的算子能够从无标签混合数据中恢复机制，并组合成对未见方程的零样本模拟器；冻结的库还可以在没有标签且不发生遗忘的情况下，扩展一个用于预训练中未出现物理现象的算子。在 Navier-Stokes 上，所发现算子的组合精度与监督训练得到的对应算子大致相当。

    Existing interpretability tools do not test whether a representation keeps the same content when only the phrasing changes. We treat each paraphrase pair as a local witness that two activations should agree and build a cellular sheaf over the paraphrase graph; its Laplacian $L_\mathcal{F}$ answers the question on a frozen model with no training. The kernel $H^0$ is a content subspace: at 20 dimensions it beats the preserved subspace of the concept eraser LEACE on held-out CounterFact fact retrieval across eight architectures by a mean $+17.1$\,pp, and constraining all paraphrases of a fact jointly adds a further $+6.5$\,pp. The spectral complement concentrates causal influence: ablating the most paraphrase-variable coordinates, a coordinate-wise proxy for it, changes model outputs $5.6$ to $26.5\times$ more than ablating coordinates of matched per-coordinate variability, across nine models from 124M to 13B parameters. The same paraphrase graph yields the content subspace, the influence directions, and the fragility measure. Project page: https://cwru-aism.github.io/gluing-lc-page/

    The Surprising Expressivity of a Single Neuron with Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought

    自回归思维链下单个神经元令人惊讶的表达能力

    Roey Magen, Nirmit Joshi and Gal Vardi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that one autoregressive neuron can efficiently simulate circuits and Turing machines using chain-of-thought, with bounds on its expressivity and an illustrative learning experiment. This directly advances theoretical understanding of reasoning computation; circuit simulation is only an expressivity result, with no substantive study of compositional representations or internal mechanisms.

    本文表明，单个自回归神经元可以借助思维链高效模拟电路和图灵机，并给出了其表达能力界限以及一项示例性学习实验。这直接推进了对推理计算的理论理解；电路模拟只是表达能力结果，并未实质性研究组合表示或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The success of autoregressive language models trained with Chain-of-Thought~(CoT) supervision raises a fundamental question: How simple can a next-token predictor be while still enabling the efficient simulation of general computation through its autoregressively generated CoT? Surprisingly, we show that a single neuron suffices. For a broad family of activations, including threshold and ReLU, a single autoregressive neuron can simulate any feedforward circuit with the same activation. Specifically, a size-$s$ circuit on $n$ inputs can be simulated by a neuron of dimension $O(ns+s^2)$ using $O(s^2)$ generation steps, with both bounds independent of circuit depth and tight under natural assumptions. For threshold activations, this improves upon the simulation of Joshi et al. (COLT 2025), whose bounds scale exponentially with circuit depth. Consequently, autoregressive threshold neurons can simulate polynomial-time Turing machines, while remaining efficiently learnable from CoT supervision. Our main expressivity result relies on a novel connection to Sidon sets from additive combinatorics. As an experimental illustration, we efficiently train a single autoregressive ReLU neuron to mimic a neural network teacher with nontrivial test accuracy on CIFAR-10.

(COLT 2025) 的模拟方法，其界随电路深度呈指数增长。因此，自回归阈值神经元能够模拟多项式时间图灵机，同时仍可通过 CoT 监督高效学习。我们的主要表达能力结果基于与加法组合学中 Sidon 集的一种新联系。作为实验示例，我们高效训练了一个自回归 ReLU 神经元，使其模仿一个神经网络教师模型，并在 CIFAR-10 上取得了非平凡的测试准确率。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As LLM agents take on more autonomous roles, they may interact with multiple clients and counterparties whose goals and incentives conflict. If an agent maintains shared inference state across these interactions, information associated with one relationship may influence decisions made for another. We test OLMo-3-7B-Instruct in a controlled two-client environment with 20 market scenarios, where each client is assigned an opposing objective. With shared conversational memory, the model deviates from the current client's objective in 22% of eligible decisions. We then investigate how these goals are represented in the KV cache. Linear probes show that client-goal ownership becomes highly recoverable in middle layers and is concentrated in particular attention heads. We use these results to identify where to intervene in the cache and test whether these representations affect the model's decisions. Ablating the competitor's cached goal representations at these locations shifts the model toward the current client. The effect is larger for heads identified by probing than for randomly selected heads, and larger when ablating goal tokens than matched non-goal tokens from the same client. Our results show that client-specific goal representations persist in the KV cache and can causally influence decisions made for other clients, highlighting the importance of relationship-specific state isolation in persistent LLM agents.

What is new is not the concept of an agent, nor runtime policy generation per se, but its general-purpose, open-ended form, in which systems can synthesize courses of action from goals, observations, and memory, over tools and environments for which no complete task-specific model was specified in advance. Thus agency becomes a systems-level abstraction as well as an AI modeling concept. Where the process abstraction organizes computation around executing programs, agency organizes it around pursuing goals under bounded resources: a process executes a program; an agent pursues a goal. From this perspective, the recurring failures of deployed agentic systems (runaway resource consumption, behavior redirected by adversarial content, opaque continuous operation) are symptoms of structural abstraction gaps, not isolated engineering defects.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how to allocate inference compute across coding-agent teams, finding that planning workers, model choice, and team size affect reward and cost. This offers strong transferable insight into agent organization and resource allocation, with a partial connection to reasoning through planning; it does not investigate internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文研究如何在编程智能体团队间分配推理计算，发现规划工作智能体、模型选择和团队规模都会影响奖励与成本。这为智能体组织和资源分配提供了很有价值且可迁移的见解，并通过规划与推理有一定关联；但没有探究模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent systems promise a new axis for scaling inference: rather than having one agent think longer or sample more attempts, a task is split across many agents that work in parallel and coordinate. However, in practice, more agents can easily produce duplicate work, coordination failures, and higher costs. We therefore formulate team design as a compute allocation problem: starting from a solo agent, where should additional inference compute go to reach the reward-cost Pareto frontier? We build a minimal multi-agent harness from the ground up and trace this frontier by varying, one at a time, the workflow stage at which a lead delegates to its workers (planning, implementation, or verification), the models that form the team, and the number of workers. On ProgramBench, teams outperform solo agents but cost three to seven times as much. With the right compute allocation, however, a heterogeneous 17-agent team comes within 1.4 points of a strong homogeneous 5-agent team at 70% lower cost. This efficiency stems from three findings. First, planning is the most valuable use of workers: in a homogeneous team whose lead decides how many workers to spawn, a lead that delegates only planning to its workers, and then implements and verifies the code itself, matches the reward of a lead that delegates to workers throughout planning, implementation, and verification, at half the cost. Second, cheap models pay off as planners but not as implementers: a strong lead with cheap planners recovers 47.5% of the reward gain of an all-strong team for only 13.9% of its additional cost, whereas cheap implementers lower reward. Third, planners keep improving reward as the team grows, whereas implementers and verifiers plateau beyond four workers. Together, our results offer a guide to spending an agent budget where it counts, given the task, cost, and latency constraints a user has.

    多智能体系统为扩展推理提供了新的维度：任务可以拆分给多个并行协作的智能体，而非让单个智能体思考更久或采样更多次。然而在实践中，增加智能体很容易造成重复工作、协作失败和成本上升。因此，我们将团队设计表述为计算分配问题：从单个智能体出发，要把额外的推理计算分配到哪里，才能达到奖励—成本帕累托前沿？我们从头构建了一个精简的多智能体框架，并逐项改变以下因素来描绘这一前沿：负责人将任务委派给工作智能体的工作流阶段（规划、实现或验证）、团队所用的模型，以及工作智能体的数量。在 ProgramBench 上，团队表现优于单个智能体，但成本是其三至七倍。然而，通过合理分配计算资源，一个由 17 个智能体组成的异构团队，成本低 70%，表现与强大的同质 5 智能体团队相差仅 1.4 分。这种效率源自三项发现。第一，规划是工作智能体最有价值的用途：在由负责人决定生成多少个工作智能体的同质团队中，只将规划任务交给工作智能体、随后自行实现并验证代码的负责人，能够以一半成本达到将规划、实现和验证全程都委派给工作智能体的负责人的奖励。第二，廉价模型适合做规划者，但不适合做实现者：由强模型负责人搭配廉价规划者，能够获得全强模型团队奖励增益的 47.5%，而额外成本仅为其 13.9%；廉价实现者则会降低奖励。第三，随着团队扩大，规划者能持续提升奖励，而工作智能体中的实现者和验证者在超过四个后便趋于平稳。综合来看，我们的结果为如何根据任务、成本和延迟约束，将智能体预算花在关键之处提供了指导。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    本文研究长 CoT 蒸馏为何能提升推理能力，提出行为上与推理模式对齐比事实知识更重要，并分析损失函数的选择如何与模式复杂度相互作用。这项工作直接涉及推理能力的发展；结构化模式与组合的关联仅属附带，且摘要未研究内部机制或系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While long chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation significantly improves the reasoning abilities of language models, its underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. Current pipelines generally rely on rejection sampling to gather reasoning traces across diverse prompts, assuming that factual correctness and broad problem coverage are indispensable. Surprisingly, we find that training exclusively on flawed reasoning trajectories or a restricted prompt set yields nearly comparable performance. Driven by this counterintuitive finding, we propose the Behavioral Hypothesis: the essence of Long-CoT distillation is behavioral alignment with structured reasoning patterns, rather than factual knowledge memorization. We then validate this by demonstrating substantial reasoning gains even when models are fine-tuned exclusively on previously mastered problems-effectively isolating behavioral alignment from novel knowledge injection. Having established that reasoning patterns are the true bottleneck, we investigate how to learn them across varying levels of complexity optimally. We reveal a critical interplay: while the recent probability-based loss excels at learning simple patterns, the standard cross-entropy loss is essential for scaling to complex CoTs. We believe these insights demystify CoT distillation and provide a principled foundation for the future development of reasoning models. Code is available on https://github.com/yuyongcan/Long-CoT-Distillation.

    尽管长链式思维（CoT）蒸馏显著提升了语言模型的推理能力，其内在机制仍缺乏充分理解。当前流程通常依赖拒绝采样，从多种提示中收集推理轨迹，并假定事实正确性和广泛的问题覆盖不可或缺。令人意外的是，我们发现，仅使用有缺陷的推理轨迹或受限的提示集进行训练，也能取得几乎相当的性能。基于这一反直觉发现，我们提出“行为假说”：长 CoT 蒸馏的本质是与结构化推理模式进行行为对齐，而非记忆事实知识。随后，我们通过展示以下结果验证这一点：即使模型只在此前已经掌握的问题上进行微调，也能显著提升推理能力，从而有效地将行为对齐与新知识注入区分开来。在确认推理模式才是真正瓶颈后，我们进一步研究如何以最优方式学习不同复杂度的模式。我们揭示了一种关键的相互作用：近期提出的基于概率的损失擅长学习简单模式，而标准交叉熵损失则是扩展到复杂 CoT 的必要条件。我们认为，这些见解揭开了 CoT 蒸馏的神秘面纱，并为未来推理模型的发展提供了有原则的基础。代码见 https://github.com/yuyongcan/Long-CoT-Distillation。

    Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) can solve complex problems beyond the reach of a single agent by decomposing tasks and coordinating complementary capabilities. Despite extensive research on MAS, existing work largely focuses on specific aspects or individual phases of their development and operation, resulting in fragmented perspectives with objectives and signals that are difficult to reconcile across these different settings. To bridge these disconnected perspectives, we conceptualize MAS development and operation as a three-phase lifecycle spanning design-time orchestration before execution, runtime intervention during execution, and post-hoc attribution after execution, and introduce MAS-Gate, a unified node-centric quantification applicable across these phases. Modeling each execution as a directed acyclic graph, MAS-Gate combines within-node utility, which estimates a node's contribution through changes in reference-answer likelihood, with inter-node strength, which approximates semantic uptake and potential downstream reach. We adapt this shared quantification to three objectives: providing a structure-aware dense reward for Orchestrator training, training an Editor to act on execution prefixes using paired rewards from completed edited and unedited trajectories, and supplying risk-ranked nodes as auxiliary evidence for LLM-based post-hoc attribution. Experiments spanning interaction environments, knowledge-intensive multi-hop question answering, general reasoning, and post-hoc attribution demonstrate that MAS-Gate improves workflow construction, targeted runtime editing, and LLM-assisted error localization over corresponding phase-specific baselines. Together, these results establish MAS-Gate as a unified structural interface for improving MAS generation, dynamic editing, and error attribution throughout the lifecycle.

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) improves reasoning but incurs substantial autoregressive rationale cost. Continuous CoT moves intermediate computation into recurrent hidden states, yet typically uses a fixed number of updates even though the best budget varies across questions and accuracy need not improve monotonically with $K$. We introduce Dynamic K-Head, a question-conditioned, pre-rollout budget selector. It is jointly trained with the reasoner under selected budgets, using difficulty supervision based on scores assigned from the question alone. We also show that latent-update count can misrepresent end-to-end cost because a short latent rollout can shift computation into a longer explicit continuation. We therefore count latent updates, implementation-specific special tokens, and all decoded text. Instantiated with CoDI on Llama 3.2 1B and GSM8K, Dynamic K-Head reaches 54.44% exact-match accuracy at 12.03 average reasoning/output tokens, compared with 52.31% at 15.21 tokens for fixed-$K=6$ CoDI---a 2.12-point gain with 20.9% lower token cost. Across three out-of-distribution arithmetic datasets, it reduces cost by 19.3--25.7% while improving accuracy by 0.30--2.22 points. These results demonstrate that difficulty-supervised budget selection can improve both accuracy and efficiency, while stable budget selection remains a central challenge.

    Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by externalizing explicit reasoning traces before producing the answer, yet suffer from overthinking challenge that allocates uniformly heavy computation to queries of varying difficulty. While proprietary models mitigate this via opaque routing, open-source LRMs still lack an efficient mechanism to internalize adaptive reasoning due to both expensive training cost and limited disclosure of training recipes. In response, we introduce RPO (Root-token Policy Optimization), a framework that enables LRMs to self-determine when to reason by training only the initial root token (e.g., whether to invoke the <think> tag) via group relative reward and group-wise advantages.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper exposes shortcut flaws in higher-order theory-of-mind evaluations, introduces certified questions, and presents an inference-time method that improves nested-perspective reasoning.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Theory of mind (ToM), the ability to reason about others' mental states, underlies effective communication and coordination. Its higher-order form enables reasoning over nested perspectives in strategic interactions. However, existing evaluations often equate belief-nesting depth with reasoning order, allowing nominally higher-order questions to admit lower-order shortcuts. We formalize effective order through the distinct events supporting successive belief prefixes, revealing widespread order inflation across existing benchmarks. We introduce HopToM, with certified full-order questions and controls for lower-order alternatives. Under direct prompting, mean accuracy across four frontier LLMs falls from 73.5% at first order to 20.0% at fourth order, and human participants also struggle. Causal interventions link a recurring class of errors to evidence for shallower belief prefixes. We introduce HopTrace, a plug-and-play inference-time method that encodes each interaction once into perspective records and resolves nested queries deterministically. On certified narrative questions, it improves fourth- and fifth-order accuracy by 22.0 and 38.5 percentage points over strong prompting baselines, while using 20-39 times fewer tokens than multi-call methods. These results sharpen how higher-order ToM is evaluated and offer a practical way to improve perspective reasoning in interactive agents.

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent collaboration has emerged as a critical paradigm for tackling complex, long-horizon tasks; however, while coordination protocols continue to advance, systemic failures at the inter-agent collaboration interface remain a pervasive bottleneck. In collaborative workflows, systems frequently suffer from \emph{broken handoffs}---where critical task context is omitted, misrouted, or ignored despite each agent emitting locally plausible responses. To address this challenge, we present \method, a verifiable runtime control framework that treats handoff repair as selective intervention over explicit dependency graphs. Central to \method is an integrated fault-attribution and calibration pipeline, \dataset, which decouples execution dependencies and injects counterfactual handoff perturbations to provide empirical supervision for runtime intervention. Leveraging this diagnostic foundation, \method dynamically compiles observable interaction traces into a provenance graph to pinpoint unresolved dependencies, without accessing private agent states. It then evaluates candidate repairs through an empirical gate that weighs expected gains against disruption risks, and executes repairs only when formal local postconditions hold. Extensive evaluations across demanding benchmarks demonstrate that \method boosts task success by up to 12.3 absolute percentage points on SILO-BENCH and 11.1 on TeamBench. Across both backbones, \method maintains strict cost-effectiveness, adding as little as 2.0\% marginal token overhead. Furthermore, on 562 handoff-relevant traces from the MAST benchmark, \method achieves 69.8\% F1 in a single pass, establishing a reliable operational boundary for verifiable coordination repair.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Persona vectors are linear directions in the residual-stream activations of LLMs that encode behavioral traits and enable fine-grained control over model behavior. Among them, the evil persona vector is particularly relevant to understanding harmful behavior, jailbreak vulnerabilities, and the unlearning of harmful knowledge. Yet whether this vector reflects a genuinely cross-lingual concept, rather than an artifact of its extraction language, remains untested. We conduct a systematic evil-vector transfer study across two high-resource languages (English, Spanish) and two low-resource languages (Swahili, Telugu) on four open-source instruction-tuned LLMs, and find that transfer is directionally asymmetric. Evil vectors are harder to obtain reliably from low-resource languages, and the resulting vectors are largely ineffective at steering, even within their own language. In contrast, vectors extracted from high-resource languages transfer effectively to low-resource inputs while largely preserving general knowledge, as measured by MMLU. Geometric analysis further supports this pattern: evil vectors from the two high-resource languages are closely aligned, whereas low-resource vectors align only weakly with this shared direction. These results suggest that a shared cross-lingual evil direction exists and, once reliably extracted from a high-resource language, can be reused to steer behavior in low-resource languages without additional per-language data collection.

    中文

    人格向量是 LLM 残差流激活中的线性方向，用于编码行为特征，并支持对模型行为进行精细控制。其中，邪恶人格向量对于理解有害行为、越狱漏洞以及有害知识的遗忘尤为重要。然而，该向量反映的究竟是真正的跨语言概念，还是提取语言造成的假象，尚未得到检验。我们在四个开源指令微调 LLM 上，对两种资源丰富语言（英语、西班牙语）和两种资源匮乏语言（斯瓦希里语、泰卢固语）开展了系统的邪恶向量迁移研究，发现迁移具有方向不对称性。从资源匮乏语言中可靠地获得邪恶向量更困难，而且由此得到的向量几乎无法有效引导模型行为，即使在其自身语言中也是如此。相比之下，从资源丰富语言中提取的向量能够有效迁移到资源匮乏语言的输入，同时大体保留一般知识，这一保留情况通过 MMLU 衡量。几何分析进一步支持这一模式：从两种资源丰富语言中提取的邪恶向量彼此高度对齐，而资源匮乏语言中的向量与这一共享方向仅弱对齐。这些结果表明，存在一个共享的跨语言邪恶方向；一旦从资源丰富的语言中可靠地提取出来，就可以将其复用于引导资源匮乏语言中的行为，而无需额外收集每种语言的数据。

    The paper directly evaluates whether SAE-feature attributions reflect causal effects, finding that agreement among attribution methods is not reliable and distinguishing importance from directional faithfulness.     本文直接评估 SAE 特征归因是否反映因果效应，发现归因方法之间的一致性并不可靠，并区分了重要性忠实性与方向性忠实性。这是对机制可解释性的核心贡献；情感分类设置仅用作测试平台。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse autoencoders decompose language model representations into interpretable features, but feature interpretation in this literature remains predominantly correlational. Attribution methods offer more direct estimates of feature influence, yet their faithfulness to actual causal effects has not been systematically evaluated in the SAE setting. We apply SHAP-based attribution to SAE latent features and evaluate it against direct causal intervention, using sentiment classification on SST-2 with GPT-2 Small and a 32,768-feature layer-7 SAE as a testbed. We compare SHAP to Integrated Gradients, Gradient$\times$Input, and probe-weight baselines across linear and MLP probe arms, scoring each against feature ablation and activation steering measured through the language model's own logit difference. Most faithfulness associations we measure do not survive multiple-comparison correction, and attribution methods that agree strongly with one another ($\rho = 0.42$--$0.80$) agree poorly with measured causal effects, indicating that inter-method agreement is not evidence of causal faithfulness. Two effects hold under control. First, local per-example attribution retains a directional advantage over global averaged attribution, while its apparent importance advantage is explained by feature activity rather than superior causal ranking. Second, under known-ground-truth minimal pairs, attribution recovers inserted sentiment signal well above chance (AUROC $0.792$) but fails to localize deletions (AUROC $0.520$), suggesting that these methods detect the presence of a feature's influence more reliably than its absence. We argue that importance faithfulness and directional faithfulness are separable properties requiring separate evaluation, and that attribution agreement should not substitute for causal validation.

    稀疏自编码器将语言模型表示分解为可解释的特征，但该领域的特征解释仍主要是相关性分析。归因方法能够更直接地估计特征影响，但其在 SAE 场景中是否忠实反映实际因果效应，尚未得到系统评估。我们将基于 SHAP 的归因应用于 SAE 潜在特征，并通过直接因果干预评估其效果。我们以 GPT-2 Small 和一个含 32,768 个特征的第 7 层 SAE 上的 SST-2 情感分类作为测试平台。我们将 SHAP 与 Integrated Gradients、Gradient$\times$Input 以及探针权重基线进行比较，涵盖线性探针和 MLP 探针两种设置；并以特征消融和激活引导作为评估依据，通过语言模型自身的 logit 差值进行测量。我们测得的大多数忠实性关联未能通过多重比较校正；彼此高度一致的归因方法（$\rho = 0.42$--$0.80$）与测得的因果效应却吻合较差，这表明方法间一致并不能证明因果忠实性。在控制条件下，有两项效应成立。第一，局部的逐样本归因仍具有方向性优势，但其表面上的重要性优势可由特征活动度解释，并非源于更优的因果排序。第二，在已知真实标签的最小对照样本中，归因能够以远高于随机猜测的水平找回插入的情感信号（AUROC $0.792$），但无法定位删除操作（AUROC $0.520$）；这表明，与检测特征影响不存在相比，这些方法更可靠地检测其存在。我们认为，重要性忠实性和方向性忠实性是彼此独立的属性，需要分别评估；归因方法之间的一致性不应取代因果验证。

    The paper develops efficient mask-aware attention kernels and distributed context-parallel execution, with algorithmic contributions to mask localization, load balancing, and communication overlap. Its attention masks are a systems concern, not an investigation of internal representations or compositional or reasoning capabilities.

    本文开发了高效的掩码感知注意力内核和分布式上下文并行执行方法，并在掩码定位、负载均衡和通信重叠方面作出算法贡献。其注意力掩码是系统层面的考量，并非对内部表示、组合能力或推理能力的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-context training of large language and multimodal models couples structured attention masks (document, prefix-LM, share-question, sliding-window, block-sparse) with multi-node context parallelism, making the mask a dominant bottleneck. Implemented for Ampere GPUs, it neither exploits FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA warp-specialized pipeline on Hopper nor supports distribution. The column-wise sparse mask is indexed by key positions but stores query-axis interval boundaries. Under any multi-chunk context-parallel assignment, it reduces per-rank mask localization to a provably zero-communication \emph{clip--shift--max} on the boundary vectors, compatible with the single-GPU kernel. FlashMask-3 introduces a mask-aware Hopper kernel with three-role warp specialization atop FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA pipeline, plus a mask-aware distributed extension: zero-communication mask localization, a sparsity-aware load balancer (HCC-IPO), and a mask-aware compute-communication overlap with mask-driven communication pruning, whose forward all-gather uses topology-aware hierarchical routing. On a single H100 across 12 masks at 4K--128K context, it improves achieved TFLOPs over FlashMask, FlexAttention, and MagiAttention by 45--141%, 34--71%, and 2--44%. At context-parallel degrees 4--32 with 8K sequence per device, it attains 31--75% compute-communication overlap efficiency and improves throughput over Megatron-Core CP ring, Megatron-Core CP all-gather, and MagiAttention by $1.80\times$--$3.71\times$, $1.71\times$--$2.92\times$, and $1.09\times$--$1.46\times$.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SHELDON separately represents and jointly explores hypothesis and observation spaces, enabling scientific discovery beyond local hypothesis refinement and improving benchmark results and novel-solution generation.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-time scaling has enabled LLMs to solve increasingly complex reasoning, discovery, and optimization tasks. However, existing approaches often gather observations while seeking evidence for current hypotheses, then generate new hypotheses conditioned on those hypotheses and their associated evidence. This couples observation discovery to existing hypotheses, favoring local refinements over exploration of unknown hypotheses regions. Inspired by the hypothetico-deductive method (Hempel, 1945) and dual-space models of scientific discovery (Klahr & Dunbar, 1988), we introduce SHELDON, a scientific reasoning harness that separately represents and jointly explores hypothesis and observation spaces. By actively seeking new observations along with new hypotheses, SHELDON can discover observations that its current hypotheses do not explain. These unexplained observations expose gaps in its understanding, motivate new investigations, and guide the generation of hypotheses beyond refinements of existing ones. Across diagnosis, abstract reasoning, and optimization benchmarks, SHELDON outperforms evaluated baselines by up to 26.7 points. Additional analysis shows that SHELDON generates up to 4.5x more novel solutions.

    ENGLISH

    Scaling interactive environments is important for training long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning. These environments often require further testing and refinement after initial generation, and correcting defects in a task may also require updating its work context and verifier. However, existing construction pipelines offer limited support for such iterative refinement while keeping these components aligned. We introduce WorkRover, a framework for training long-horizon cowork agents through recursive environment evolution. Its harness-driven synthesis enables construction agents to jointly build and validate semantically aligned work contexts, executable tasks, and evidence-grounded verifiers, adapting their actions to workspace state and execution feedback rather than following a fixed construction workflow. To support environment evolution, we introduce Factorial Compatibility Replay (FCR), which uses rollout feedback to evaluate combinations of component revisions through dependency-closed replay and selects the smallest validated repair among tested candidates while preserving task requirements and evaluation constraints. Using WorkRover, we post-train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to obtain WorkRover-35B-A3B and evaluate it on several cowork-agent benchmarks. Its reported scores exceed those of Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 26.27 percentage points on JobBench, 29.32 percentage points on OfficeQA Pro, and 413.25 Elo points on GDPval v2. These results suggest that WorkRover offers a promising foundation for scalable training of long-horizon cowork agents.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    QRR 研究潜在动力学如何影响循环推理中的收敛，并引入与对称性解耦的旋转自由度，以避免缓慢振荡瓶颈；其评估涵盖结构化推理任务。商表征提供了一些几何见解，但本文所述贡献的核心是推理动力学，而非学习特征的解释或组合。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped reasoning with dynamic depth can be viewed as relaxation toward solution attractors in a learned dynamical landscape. In practice, however, latent trajectories often oscillate, cycle, or drift rather than cleanly converge to stable fixed points. How these non-stationary dynamics contribute to reasoning and constrain convergence remains unclear. We show that slowly decaying oscillatory modes can impose their convergence rate on coupled latent dynamics, creating a bottleneck. Yet damping these modes indiscriminately can disrupt the reasoning computation they support. This tension motivates an architectural approach: introducing rotational degrees of freedom along which symmetry-generated rotational motion leaves the reasoning-relevant quotient dynamics unchanged by construction. We propose QRR (Quotient Recurrent Reasoner), a gauge-equivariant recurrent architecture with an exact per-token phase-rotation symmetry. Motion along these symmetry directions leaves the quotient representation unchanged and is dynamically decoupled from reasoning-relevant dynamics. Empirically, QRR achieves stable and faster convergence to solution roots in quotient space, without forming a dominant slow oscillatory bottleneck, while matching or surpassing recent recurrent reasoning models on Sudoku, Maze, and Mini-ARC.

    具有动态深度的循环推理可以被视为在学习到的动力学景观中朝解吸引子松弛的过程。然而在实践中，潜在轨迹往往会振荡、循环或漂移，而不是干净地收敛到稳定的不动点。这些非平稳动力学如何促进推理、又如何限制收敛，仍不清楚。我们证明，缓慢衰减的振荡模态会将其收敛速率施加给耦合的潜在动力学，从而形成瓶颈。然而，不加区分地抑制这些模态可能会破坏它们所支撑的推理计算。这种张力促使我们采用一种架构方案：引入旋转自由度，使对称性产生的旋转运动按构造不改变与推理相关的商空间动力学。我们提出 QRR（商空间循环推理器），这是一种具有精确逐 token 相位旋转对称性的规范等变循环架构。沿这些对称方向的运动不会改变商表征，并且在动力学上与推理相关动力学解耦。实证结果表明，QRR 在商空间中能够稳定且更快地收敛到解根，同时不会形成占主导地位的缓慢振荡瓶颈；在 Sudoku、Maze 和 Mini-ARC 上，其表现不逊于或优于近期循环推理模型。

On the pretraining task, two streams reduce reconstruction perplexity by 5.71% on validation data and 5.13% on average across external corpora compared with standard residual connections. We observe that, without predefined roles, visible and masked positions learn distinct routing patterns. Causal interventions show that this distinction organizes read and write routing, while token-specific write strength remains important within each role. Guided by these findings, a model trained with role-conditioned routing recovers half the validation gain from adding a second stream. State interventions explain the benefit of the additional stream: it preserves early token representations for later reuse while evidence accumulates at masked positions.     Prompt-based adaptation offers several ways to specialize a frozen language model, ranging from natural-language prompt optimization to learned continuous prompts. These methods are usually compared through downstream performance, although similar outputs need not arise from similar internal computations. We study how discrete prompt optimization, prompt tuning, and prefix tuning alter the processing of dense and mixture-of-experts language models. Our analysis shows that the location of the adaptation predicts how task information is carried to the output: optimized text primarily changes response construction, input-level prompts write their influence into content representations, and layer-wise prefixes maintain direct control through attention. In MoE models, these differences further induce distinct expert-routing patterns. At the same time, common representation-level measurements respond strongly to generic context changes and do not reliably distinguish useful adaptations from matched placebos. We argue that understanding prompt adaptation requires separating representation drift from the part of that drift that is aligned with, and causally used by, the model's task computation. This perspective provides practical guidance for selecting, evaluating, and interpreting prompt adaptation methods.
