    The safety of LLM-based agents currently rests on alignment training and safety classifiers, neither of which can rule out that a sophisticated indirect prompt injection (IPI) goes through and causes significant harm. Recent work therefore builds agents with information-flow guarantees that rely on structured tool interfaces to interact with the environment. Computer Use Agents (CUAs) act visually on the computer screen, which does not provide a boundary between trusted first-party interfaces and untrusted, potentially attacker-authored content. Actions are equally ambiguous: a click may land on an application toolbar or a button controlled by an attacker. Treating the user as the source of trust and confirming each sensitive decision produces confirmation fatigue, with the risk of missing harmful actions. We introduce SA-CUA, a dual-LLM framework that generates a reliable trust boundary for CUAs by deriving conservative deterministic rules from the accessibility tree for unmasking trusted regions from the privileged LLM's screenshot, keeping trusted and untrusted content separated. Human interaction is only required for proper task specification in the beginning. During the task a robust endorsement channel allows values to pass from the untrusted to the trusted domain by verifying information via trusted channels. This allows the agent to autonomously handle tasks involving untrusted information. SA-CUA maintains much higher utility than CaMeL-CUA while keeping the attack success rate at zero.

    中文

    目前，基于 LLM 的代理安全性依赖于对齐训练和安全分类器，但两者都无法排除复杂的间接提示注入（IPI）得逞并造成重大伤害的可能性。因此，近期工作转而构建具有信息流保证的代理，依靠结构化工具接口与环境交互。计算机使用代理（CUA）通过视觉操作计算机屏幕，而屏幕无法划分可信的第一方界面与不可信的、可能由攻击者撰写的内容。操作也同样含糊：一次点击可能落在应用程序工具栏上，也可能落在由攻击者控制的按钮上。将用户视为信任源，并对每个敏感决策都要求确认，会造成确认疲劳，增加漏掉有害操作的风险。我们推出 SA-CUA，这是一个双 LLM 框架，它从辅助功能树中推导保守的确定性规则，用于从特权 LLM 的屏幕截图中揭示可信区域，从而为 CUA 建立可靠的信任边界，并将可信内容与不可信内容分开。只有在开始时正确指定任务才需要人工交互。任务执行期间，稳健的背书通道会通过可信通道验证信息，使值能够从不可信域传递到可信域。这样，代理便能自主处理涉及不可信信息的任务。SA-CUA 在将攻击成功率保持为零的同时，维持了远高于 CaMeL-CUA 的实用性。

    Knowing the User Is Not Knowing What We Established: Grounding Awareness in Personal Agents

    了解用户不等于了解我们共同确立了什么：个人智能体中的落地状态感知

    Jiajun Chen, Xinyue Chen, Yicheng Jiang, Hua Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces Grounding Awareness and a benchmark, traces failures through memory and action selection, and proposes a lightweight status-tracking layer for personal agents. This is a core contribution to agent memory and action systems; the failure tracing is only partial evidence about internal mechanisms, and the abstract does not establish compositional or general reasoning advances.

    本文提出落地状态感知及相应基准，追踪记忆和行动选择环节中的失败，并为个人智能体提出轻量级状态跟踪层。这是对智能体记忆和行动系统的核心贡献；失败追踪仅为内部机制提供了部分证据，摘要也没有证明其在组合推理或一般推理方面有所进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Personal-agent memory has largely focused on learning what users know, prefer, and want. However, knowing the user does not necessarily mean knowing what the user and the agent have established together. An assistant's proposal should not become an authorized instruction merely because it is remembered. We introduce Grounding Awareness, the ability to distinguish accepted, unacknowledged, revised, and scoped arrangements when selecting actions. We develop a controlled benchmark to test whether agents can tell the difference between proposals users have accepted and those they have not, and whether they apply accepted arrangements only where appropriate. Across multiple agents and memory systems, we find that strong memory performance does not ensure Grounding Awareness. More surprisingly, providing more complete user information can increase execution of unacknowledged proposals, while persistent memory can cause agents to treat these proposals as if they were user instructions. We trace these failures through memory writing, retrieval, and action selection. Finally, we introduce Grounding Layer, a lightweight, training-free extension that explicitly tracks grounding status and checks consequential actions, substantially improving agent behavior without modifying models or memory systems.

    中文

    个人智能体的记忆研究主要聚焦于学习用户知道什么、偏好什么以及想要什么。然而，了解用户并不一定意味着了解用户与智能体共同确立了什么。助手提出的建议不应仅仅因为被记住，就变成已获授权的指令。我们提出“落地状态感知”（Grounding Awareness），即在选择行动时区分已接受、未确认、已修订和有适用范围限制的约定的能力。我们开发了一个受控基准，用于测试智能体能否区分用户已接受和未接受的建议，以及它们是否只在适当情形下应用已接受的约定。在多种智能体和记忆系统上，我们发现，强大的记忆表现并不能确保具备落地状态感知。更令人意外的是，提供更完整的用户信息可能会增加智能体执行未确认建议的情况，而持久记忆可能导致智能体将这些建议当作用户指令。我们追踪了这些失败在记忆写入、检索和行动选择环节中的表现。最后，我们提出 Grounding Layer，这是一种轻量级、无需训练的扩展，它会显式跟踪落地状态并检查后果重大的行动，在不修改模型或记忆系统的情况下显著改善智能体行为。

    Self-Evolving Agent Harness

    自我演进的智能体框架

    Chuyang Wei, Haoxiang Guan, Minghang Zhu, Kexin Zhou, Jiyan He, Xiren Zhou, Huanhuan Chen, Yifei Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes agents that revise persistent prompts, memory, workflows, and code, and analyzes reliability and generalization of those revisions. This is a core agent-systems contribution; plugin reuse and workflow optimization are incidental to compositional generalization and reasoning.

    本文将能够修订持久化提示词、记忆、工作流和代码的智能体形式化，并分析这些修订的可靠性和泛化能力。这是对智能体系统的核心贡献；插件复用和工作流优化对于组合泛化与推理而言只是附带内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.

    中文

    框架的自我演进会修改智能体的软件脚手架，包括提示词、记忆、工作流和可执行组件，同时保持模型权重不变。我们将一种由反馈驱动的过程形式化，其中被接受的修订会在多次运行中持续保留。该框架将更新目标与提议机制和准入机制区分开来。它区分对解释状态的更改与对工具和代码、仓库级控制逻辑以及插件组合的修订。我们通过进化优化刻画搜索，并通过持续 PAC 学习考察其可靠性。在明确的假设下，分析得出期望泛化界、以历史回归预算为条件的保留界，以及一种使用新鲜、独立验证数据的高概率准入规则。我们考察持久化的框架修订如何影响知识共享和组织工作流，以及其对科学可靠性、物理安全和机构问责的影响。先前工作的案例展示了模型与框架协同设计、分布式执行和插件复用。随着任务分布和评估器发生变化，可靠部署需要持续验证，并为学习、运行时权限和后果重大的行动设置独立的安全措施。我们提供一份全面的 66 页讨论，涵盖相关工作、理论、算法、评估、应用以及 Harness RSI 的广泛影响，并附有持续更新的代码和补充材料，见 https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI。

    Hybrid Reasoning Agents

    混合推理智能体

    Jiaru Zou, Yunzhe Qi, Sirui Chen, Federico Bianchi, Shang Zhu, Pan Lu, Jingrui He, James Zou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HybridAgents combines latent deliberation with text-based tool interaction, continuous working memory, and dedicated SFT/RL methods for deciding when to reason or act; it reports gains in capability and efficiency. This directly advances reasoning and agent-system design, while inspectable latent thoughts alone do not establish mechanistic interpretability or compositional generalization.

    HybridAgents 将潜在推演与基于文本的工具交互、连续工作记忆以及专门用于决定何时推理或行动的 SFT/RL 方法结合起来，并报告了能力与效率方面的提升。这项工作直接推动了推理和智能体系统设计；但仅凭潜在思维可检查，并不能证明存在机制可解释性或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.

    中文

    我们如何构建一种能够超越人类语言进行思考、却仍通过语言在外部环境中行动的智能体？现代 LLM 智能体仍通过文本进行推理和交互，而潜在推理提供了一种高效的内部媒介，却缺乏原生工具访问能力和推理透明度。我们通过混合推理智能体（HybridAgents）连接这两个方向，使其在统一的生成过程中动态地在潜在推理与基于文本的交互之间切换。在架构上，轻量级 HybridLink 可在文本模式和潜在模式之间无缝转换，而智能体的连续工作记忆则能在多个轮次中无损保留混合上下文。这些设计保留了集成工具的智能体能力，同时使潜在思维能够被直接检查。基于这一架构，我们进一步开发了专用于混合推理的后训练算法：HybridSFT 通过教导骨干模型与 HybridLink 协同工作，稳定集成工具的混合生成；随后 HybridRL 通过学习何时在潜在空间中思考、何时通过文本行动，扩展推理能力。我们在 3 种模型规模下、跨越 11 个基准评估 HybridAgent，涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和智能体推理。与前沿 LLM 智能体以及涵盖文本和潜在方法的智能体框架相比，HybridAgent 的性能稳定提升 10.4%，同时令 token 数减少 35.5%-54.7%、推理速度提升 1.8x-2.6x，并节省 2.7x-3.7x 的成本。代码和数据见 https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent。
